title: Lethe: Link Inference Attacks For Evaluation of Edge Unlearning Methods
abstract: arXiv:2610.21869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph Unlearning (GU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a Graph Neural Network without retraining anew. While most methods address removal of nodes and features, Edge Unlearning (EU), aiming at forgetting edges, has recently attracted dedicated attention as a standalone problem due to the hardness of completely removing the impact of an edge in the model. Despite this, no dedicated benchmark for EU exists besides isolated evaluations on feature-rich datasets such as Cora and Citeseer where GNNs exploit node features rather than graph structure. As such, we show two systematic limitations in existing evaluations: dedicated EU methods can be slower than retraining anew, and accuracy metrics are uninformative due to the negligible impact of edge removal. translated_title: Lethe：用于评估边遗忘方法的链接推断攻击
translated_abstract: 图遗忘（Graph Unlearning, GU）旨在无需重新训练的情况下，从图神经网络中移除特定训练数据的影响。尽管大多数方法针对节点和特征的移除，但边遗忘（Edge Unlearning, EU）——即遗忘边——由于在模型中完全消除一条边的影响十分困难，最近作为一个独立问题受到了专门关注。尽管如此，除了在Cora和Citeseer等特征丰富的数据集上的孤立评估（其中图神经网络利用的是节点特征而非图结构）之外，目前尚不存在专门的EU基准。因此，我们揭示了现有评估中的两个系统性局限：专门的EU方法可能比重新训练更慢，且由于边移除的影响微乎其微，准确率指标缺乏参考价值。为填补这一空白，我们提出了Lethe，这是首个全面的边遗忘基准，涵盖15种方法和8个数据集。我们的基准强调大规模……
tldr: 提出首个全面的边遗忘基准Lethe，利用链接推断攻击在15种方法和8个数据集上进行评估，并揭示现有评估方法的系统性缺陷（专用方法可能比重新训练更慢、准确率指标无参考价值）。
en_tdlr: We introduce Lethe, the first comprehensive benchmark for Edge Unlearning using link inference attacks to evaluate 15 methods across 8 datasets, revealing systematic limitations in existing evaluations.
